sections.Profile:
Deadpool, the "Merc with a Mouth", teams up with Wolverine, Dazzler, Domino and Colossus to battle X-Men villains Juggernaut, Sabretooth, Mystique and Sauron, takes his time machine on quests against a T-Rex and a Megalodon, and works toward a final showdown with Mr. Sinister. Designed by George Gomez with Nolan North voicing Deadpool, the game has players bash a Lil' Deadpool toy guarded by a three-bank drop target and send the ball down a katana-sword ramp return.
